title: On a vendor credit, searching tracked also lists untracked parts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
  • Have an untracked part, part A, with vendor A, whose part number, description and tags contain neither the word not nor the word tracked.
  • Have a tracked part, part C, with vendor A, whose part number, description and tags contain neither word, so the search has a part it must leave out.
  • Start on vendor A's page (Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then the vendor A row).
custom_steps:
1. Click the button that starts a new vendor credit.
  2. Click the Part Number field of the credit's first line.
  3. Type tracked.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A new vendor credit for vendor A opens.

Step 2:

  • The part search under Part Number is ready to type in.

Step 3:

  • Part A is listed: the word tracked finds untracked parts here too.
  • Part C is not listed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10819 (Story 6, Search and Sort the Inventory List by Tracking State), story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S6-R1a: “The part search on vendor returns and vendor credits uses the same search, so those words return untracked parts there too.”
  • S6-R1: “Typing "not tracked", "not" or "tracked" in the Inventory search returns the untracked parts, together with every part those words match on part number, description, tags and the other standard fields. Upper and lower case, and spaces before and after the term, do not matter.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-10647 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10819, Chris Ward, 23 Oct 2026: “Confirmed: A. Keep the tracking words in the shared search, including the vendor Return and Credit pickers.”
